blueprintSignals.name: Coverage check

label: For "Claims Triage & Straight-Through Processing": Route each insurance claim to straight-through payment, standard handling or a specialist based on complexity and risk. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels come from past routing decisions, so the model learns the old process and its biases.
